## TRA Timeline

#### De-SPAC and TRA execution

- 2021-01-21: De-SPAC closed (Gores Holdings IV merged with UWM); executed TRA filed as Exhibit 10.2 to the January 22, 2021 closing 8-K

#### Exchange-driven liability ramp

- 2024: SFS Corp. Exchange Transactions drive recognized TRA liability from $15.5M to $78.5M
- 2025: SFS Corp. exchanged 108,849,478 Holdings LLC units, generating a $63.0M increase in TRA liability; year-end balance reaches $196.9M; first cash payments of $0.2M made
- 2025-12-17: UWMC announced an all-stock acquisition of Two Harbors Investment Corp.; merger agreement explicitly represents the transaction is not a TRA Change of Control

## Explanation

UWM Holdings Corporation executed this TRA on January 21, 2021 at the closing of its de-SPAC Up-C business combination with Gores Holdings IV, Inc., agreeing to pay 85% of net cash tax savings from a bundle of attributes: Section 754 basis step-ups generated by SFS Holding Corp.'s future exchanges of Holdings LLC Common Units, basis from TRA payments themselves, imputed interest, and disproportionate Section 704(c) allocations. SFS Corp. (the Ishbia family vehicle) is the sole TRA counterparty. The recognized TRA liability sat near $15M from 2021 through 2023, then ramped sharply as SFS Corp. executed material Exchange Transactions: 2024 liability climbed to $78.5M and 2025 reached $196.9M with the first cash payments ($0.2M) flowing that year. The December 2025 announcement of an all-stock acquisition of Two Harbors Investment Corp. carries an explicit representation in the merger agreement (Section 5.12(o)) that the transaction is not a TRA Change of Control, so the TRA continues unchanged. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
